messages:
mira_marketing: Quick sync for tomorrow's announce — need final 2-line changelog for the email, docs permalink, benchmark gist, webinar CTA copy, and HubSpot routing details. Can we lock before EOD?
elaine_pm: scope is performance + streaming only. i'll post marketing-friendly changelog in 5.
tyler_eng: plan: canary at 07:00 UTC, 15m canary, 30m observe. ops/marketing please hold public posts until 07:50 UTC.
sophia_docs: assembling docs bundle (migration note + examples). staging preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1-preview. will publish prod permalink post-deploy.
omar_ops: will wire HubSpot webhook on success. need tag name from marketing. also will attach sample payload to the success event.
lena_sdr: routing preference: enterprise -> SDR-East, trials -> automated nurture. need tag and webhook to test.
mira_marketing: tag is `autumn-launch-2-1`. draft changelog:
- ~15% lower per-token cost for typical embedding workloads
- Streaming reliability improvements for long conversations
impact line: "Lower unit cost plus steadier streaming helps teams scale inference predictably."
tyler_eng: confirm 15% is for a common embedding profile; add "typical workloads" qualifier. no hardware specifics public.
sophia_docs: adding quick curl demo for the confirmation email: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` and will include slides + notebook at: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-demo
deploy-bot: Canary started at 07:00 UTC. Posting events to #release-war-room.
omar_ops: webhook to enable on success: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-2-1 — will test after deploy.
tyler_eng: monitoring rule: if p99 latency > baseline +20% or errors spike by >3x, we will pause and rollback. we'll notify this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary success at 07:12 UTC. Observability hold until 07:42 UTC. Event sample: { "event":"release","version":"2.1","status":"canary-success" }
mira_marketing: good — marketing will schedule social + email for 07:50 UTC once hold passes. webinar confirmation needs: docs permalink, slides link, demo notebook link, and 1-line changelog.
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — includes migration snippet and API diff.
lena_sdr: HubSpot workflow updated and webhook tested; routing live.
emergency_note: (if rollback) please @channel here and in #release-war-room
mira_marketing: thanks all. i'll post the social copy for a 1-PR review in 15 and hold here for any telemetry flags. :rocket:
